supporting_quotes.exact: Generic trees are a collection of nodes where each node is a data structure that consists of records and a list of references to its children(duplicate references are not allowed).
Unlike the linked list, each node stores the address of multiple nodes.
Every node stores address of its children and the very first node's address will be stored in a separate pointer called root.

observations.subject: generic tree
observations.object: collection of nodes, each a data structure of records plus a list of references to children (duplicate references not allowed)

observations.subject: node
observations.object: address of multiple nodes (unlike linked list)

observations.subject: node
observations.object: address of its children; first node's address stored in separate pointer called root

claims.rationale: 三条同源引文逐成分覆盖 claim：引文 f9bac1c8c445（[0,180]）'each node...consists of records and a list of references to its children(duplicate references are not allowed)'直接支持'节点由数据记录和孩子引用列表组成且不允许重复引用'；引文 46c603cf9e8c（[0,71]）'Unlike the linked list, each node stores the address of multiple nodes'支持'与链表不同，每个节点存储多个节点的地址'；引文 62968fd58026（[0,125]）'Every node stores address of its children...separate pointer called root'支持'每个节点存孩子地址、首节点地址存于独立 root 指针'。claim 为忠实转述，无引申、无矛盾。注：审计载荷未提供源文档全文，rationale_offsets 以引文自身区间 [0,引文长度] 表示该证据跨度；全部引文来自同一 source（provenance 为空，无法举证跨源独立性）。

supporting_quotes.exact: The Generic trees are the N-ary trees which have the following properties:
The number of nodes for each node is not known in advance.

claims.rationale: 引文 5263a6f6a6ac（[0,74]）'The Generic trees are the N-ary trees'直接支持'通用树是 N 叉树'；引文 fa4db717e798（[0,28]）'Many children at every node'支持'每个节点可有多个孩子'；引文 58d6bbdb5a2e（[0,58]）'The number of nodes for each node is not known in advance'支持'数量事先未知'。提示：第三条原文为'number of nodes'，在讨论孩子/兄弟的上下文中应理解为'子节点（children）数量'，与 claim'孩子数量'语义一致，但字面上存在节点/孩子之别，建议转录时留意；不构成矛盾，verdict 维持 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Memory Wastage - All the pointers are not required in all the cases. Hence, there is lot of memory wastage.
Unknown number of children - The number of children for each node is not known in advance.

observations.subject: pointer-per-child representation
observations.object: memory wastage (pointers not required in all cases)

observations.subject: pointer-per-child representation
observations.object: unknown number of children in advance

claims.rationale: 两条引文即该表示法的两大缺点条目：引文 5e89cf9c3624（[0,107]）'All the pointers are not required in all the cases. Hence, there is lot of memory wastage.'支持'多数情况下指针用不到造成大量内存浪费'；引文 519b571cd237（[0,90]）'Unknown number of children...The number of children for each node is not known in advance.'支持'孩子数量事先未知'。claim 中'导致容量难以确定'是对该缺点条目（Unknown number of children）在固定预分配语境下含义的释义，引文未逐字给出因果关系但语义一致、无冲突；两个缺点条目与 claim 逐一对应。

supporting_quotes.exact: In Linked list, we can not randomly access any child's address. So it will be expensive.
In array, we can randomly access the address of any child, but we can store only fixed number of children's addresses in it.

observations.subject: array
observations.object: randomly access any child's address but stores only fixed number of children's addresses

claims.rationale: 引文 83dfa21cbba1（[0,88]）'In Linked list, we can not randomly access any child's address. So it will be expensive.'直接支持'链表无法随机访问任意孩子地址且代价高'；引文 befe247be0b1（[0,124]）'In array, we can randomly access the address of any child, but we can store only fixed number of children's addresses in it.'直接支持'数组可随机访问但只能存固定数量孩子地址'。claim 两半与两条引文一一对应，为忠实转述，无矛盾、无超出引文的成分。

supporting_quotes.exact: We can use Dynamic Arrays for storing the address of children. We can randomly access any child's address and the size of the vector is also not fixed.

observations.subject: dynamic array
observations.object: random access to any child's address; size not fixed

claims.rationale: 引文 18a3b8828169（[0,151]）'We can use Dynamic Arrays for storing the address of children. We can randomly access any child's address and the size of the vector is also not fixed.'覆盖 claim 三成分：'动态数组存孩子地址'、'可随机访问任意孩子地址'、'容量（size）不固定'。claim 中'更好的做法'为对前文（链表不可随机访问、数组容量固定）上下文的概括性表述，引文用'We can use'推荐该方案，与上下文一致；注：引文术语为'vector'，claim 译为'容量'，语义一致，无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: In the first child/next sibling representation, the steps taken are:
At each node-link the children of the same parent(siblings) from left to right.
Remove the links from parent to all children except the first child.

observations.subject: siblings
observations.object: from left to right at each node

observations.subject: parent
observations.object: links to all children except the first child

claims.rationale: 引文 e5dcfc7cecfe（[0,68]）点明主题'first child/next sibling representation, the steps taken are'；引文 dc543a38b4da（[0,79]）'At each node-link the children of the same parent(siblings) from left to right'支持'把同一父节点的孩子们（兄弟）从左到右链接'；引文 9b50296a1951（[0,68]）'Remove the links from parent to all children except the first child'支持'移除父节点指向除第一个孩子外其他孩子的链接'。claim 中'（左孩子/右兄弟）'为 first child/next sibling 的通用翻译（同义术语，非新增事实）；三引文与 claim 逐成分对应，无矛盾。

supporting_quotes.exact: Memory efficient - No extra links are required, hence a lot of memory is saved.
Treated as binary trees - Since we are able to convert any generic tree to binary representation, we can treat all generic trees with a first child/next sibling representation as binary trees.
Many algorithms can be expressed more easily because it is just a binary tree.
Each node is of fixed size ,so no auxiliary array or vector is required.

observations.subject: algorithms
observations.object: more easily because it is just a binary tree

observations.subject: node
observations.object: fixed size; no auxiliary array or vector required

claims.rationale: 四条引文与 claim 四个优点逐一对应：引文 24f1ad12af22（[0,79]）'No extra links are required, hence a lot of memory is saved'支持'内存高效（不需要额外链接）'；引文 e4d90aa02a5b（[0,192]）'convert any generic tree to binary representation...treat all generic trees with a first child/next sibling representation as binary trees'支持'任何通用树都能转成二叉表示'（claim 中'用 firstChild/nextSibling 取代左右指针'为'作为二叉树处理'的惯用解释，与引文'with a first child/next sibling representation'语义一致）；引文 f08329fa0d14（[0,77]）'Many algorithms can be expressed more easily because it is just a binary tree'支持'算法更易表达'；引文 8266d22eb01e（[0,72]）'Each node is of fixed size ,so no auxiliary array or vector is required'支持'节点定长、无需辅助数组或向量'。四引文彼此一致，无冲突。
